propositions: Three committed format changes to .bridge_state require documentation of mixed-version protocol, rollback boundaries, and deployment gates to ensure safe rollout and discoverability across versions.

The mixed-version protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) reads and stops legacy writes only after direct deployment evidence (successful reconcile workflow, explicit host-probe refresh, no older process), with first-wins strategy being unsafe.

A2-1 last_get_pass relocation to get_rotation.json is reversible; A3 scalar baseline normalization is reversible via idempotent read-path canonicalization; A2-2 cutover supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer; A4-2 narrowing requires forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Bridge state remains committed on-branch because ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners require durable state and epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation.

Measured marginal cost reduction from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB after A1 deletion, with 218/399 identical prev_snapshot key sets (session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4), and assignee remains raw because _assignee_candidates requires its unmodified shape.

A2-2 gate requires A2-1 on main, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, refreshed host probe with recorded executable/source and no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle—direct evidence replaces elapsed-time requirement.
